}

		NOTES_USERID as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		BR as string,

		CCY as string,

		CUSTOMER as string,
		ValueDate as string,
		CustBIC as string,
		SN as string,

		PORTFOLIO as string,
		{BROKER ID} as string,
		SEQ as string,

	allowSchemaDrift: true,

tblOpicsFXUnconfirmedPhoneQueueStaging sink(input(
		Comments as string,
		AGING as string,
		CTYPE as string,
		TRANS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		NOTES_USERID as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		BR as string,
		QUEUEID as string,
		Block_customer as string,
		Loaddate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CCY as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		CUSTOMER as string,
		ValueDate as string,
		CustBIC as string,
		SN as string,

		SEQ as string,
		TRANSAMOUNT as string,
		PUBSNOTES as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Comments,
		AGING,
		CTYPE,
		TRANS_DESCRIPTION,
		NOTES_USERID,
		DEALDATE,
		BR,
		QUEUEID,
		Block_customer,
		Loaddate,
		CCY,
		DEALNO,
		CUSTOMER,
		ValueDate,
		CustBIC,
		SN,
		Block_reviewed,
		PORTFOLIO,
		BROKER_ID = {BROKER ID},
		SEQ,
		TRANSAMOUNT,

	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsFXUnconfirmedPhoneQueueArchive_outputfilename)],
